name: Parsnip
desc:
Parsnip was a Celtor NPC. They worked for the [Ignition Union](faction:the_ignition_union).

They wore the Ignition Welder outfit.
additional_info:
-   When referring to something "familiar," Parsnip was most likely referencing the Mechalodaunt to the Megalodaunt. This is further proven by finding Summer Goons fighting Mechalodaunts in [Saramaed Summit](location:saramaed_summit).
-   Parsnip's words imply Hell as a concept exists in the world of _Deepwoken_.
